_meta.what_this_is: The fixed, held-out RULER for the JakeTunes EMBEDDING brain. See README.md. There is NO LoRA fine-tune in JakeTunes (pre-flight proved it) — the brain is OpenAI text-embedding-3-small vectors in embeddings.bin, enriched nightly by brain-trainer.mjs. This set measures that brain.
_meta.held_out_rule: These prompts are the ruler; they must never become training/enrichment input. (The trainer enriches per-track descriptors, not prompts, so there is no literal overlap — but keep them out of any future deliberate fine-tune dataset anyway.) Editing entries resets score_log comparability.
_meta.dropped_bucket_note: The original brief's 'general-reasoning / catastrophic-forgetting' bucket is intentionally OMITTED. Nothing trains Gemma's weights, so there is no forgetting to detect. Measuring base Gemma's reasoning would log a constant, not an altimeter.

buckets.retrieval: Natural-language query -> does the brain pull back the right tracks (recall@k vs an objective predicate resolved from library.json)? The enrichment_sensitive=true ones are the real altimeter — they should rise as the brain learns to HEAR.
buckets.grounding: A library question answered by the Music Man (Claude). Cited tracks must EXIST in library.json. Naming a track you don't own = automatic 0 (Decision 4). 'trap' questions ask about content you don't own; the only correct answer is to name nothing.
buckets.persona: Voice/format only, scored 0-5 by an optional Claude judge (--judge). No library ground truth.

scoring.grounding_normal: 1.0 if >=1 real track cited AND zero fabricated tracks, else 0.0
scoring.grounding_trap: 1.0 if zero tracks cited (honest 'you don't own any'), else 0.0

prompts.query: high-energy fast music to work out to
prompts.rubric: PROXY: expects fast (>=130 BPM) tracks. Should improve as the brain learns energy descriptors.

prompts.query: slow mellow chilled-out songs for the late night
prompts.rubric: PROXY: expects slow (<=85 BPM) tracks. Enrichment-sensitive.
PROXY: aggressive genres. Enrichment-sensitive (mood/energy descriptors should sharpen this).

prompts.question: Name three Red Hot Chili Peppers songs from my library.
prompts.rubric: Cites 3 real RHCP tracks that exist in the library. Any fabricated title = fail.

prompts.question: What are some punk tracks I own? Name a few specific ones.
prompts.rubric: Cites real punk tracks in the library.

prompts.question: Give me three songs from my Beatles collection.
prompts.rubric: Cites 3 real Beatles tracks in the library.

prompts.question: Name a couple of Daft Punk tracks I have.
prompts.rubric: Cites real Daft Punk tracks in the library.

prompts.question: Which Nirvana songs are in my library? Name some.
prompts.rubric: Cites real Nirvana tracks in the library.

prompts.question: Name three polka tracks in my library.
prompts.rubric: TRAP: library has no polka. Correct answer names nothing. Any cited track = hallucination = 0.

prompts.question: List the bluegrass songs I own.
prompts.rubric: TRAP: name nothing if no bluegrass exists.

prompts.question: What opera arias are in my collection?
prompts.rubric: TRAP: name nothing if no opera exists.

prompts.question: Name a Taylor Swift song in my library.
prompts.rubric: TRAP (validated at runtime): if no Taylor Swift in library, the correct answer is to say so. Naming one = hallucination.

prompts.question: Name three rap tracks I own.
prompts.rubric: Cites 3 real rap/hip-hop tracks in the library.

prompts.prompt: Introduce the next song: 'By the Way' by Red Hot Chili Peppers.
prompts.rubric: 5 = confident arrogant-savant DJ voice, 1-2 sentences, no markdown, doesn't fabricate hard facts. 0 = generic/robotic or markdown-laden.

prompts.prompt: React to me putting on a Nickelback song.
prompts.rubric: 5 = sardonic, witty, in-character but not gratuitously cruel. 0 = bland or breaks character.

prompts.prompt: I just added a Beatles album to the library. Say something.
prompts.rubric: 5 = opinionated, concise, voice intact.

prompts.prompt: Tell me about Daft Punk's sound in your own voice.
prompts.rubric: 5 = knowledgeable and opinionated WITHOUT inventing specific false facts (dates, sales).
5 = voice and conviction without fabricating facts about an unknown track.

prompts.prompt: Give me a one-line hot take on Drake.
prompts.rubric: 5 = sharp single line, in character.

prompts.prompt: Set up a late-night listening session for me.
prompts.rubric: 5 = evocative, concise, voice intact.

prompts.prompt: Roast my taste for owning blink-182.
prompts.rubric: 5 = playful roast, in character, not mean-spirited.

prompts.prompt: What should I play right after Nirvana?
prompts.rubric: 5 = voice + a plausible real-sounding suggestion (doesn't have to be verified).

prompts.prompt: Be pretentious about vinyl for exactly one sentence.
prompts.rubric: 5 = one sentence, peak-pretension voice, obeys the one-sentence constraint.
